content.intro: This lesson introduces metaclasses and class creation as part of advanced python language features. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Object-oriented design is useful when state and behavior belong together. Prefer clear interfaces and composition when inheritance would create a fragile hierarchy.

content_blocks.text: A class defines behavior and can be used to create instances with associated state.
